caption: The image depicts a detailed illustration of a carved wooden figurehead in the form of a woman, set against a solid, flat, medium blue background with a subtle gradient. The figurehead is rendered in shades of off-white and light gray, without any vibrant colors, giving it a sculptural, monochromatic appearance. The woman is shown from the knees up, facing slightly to the right with her head turned even farther to the right and tilted upward. She wears a dress with multiple layers of ruffles and scalloped edges, adorned with lace-like details and a sash draped over her left shoulder. Her arms are at her sides, and there are bracelets around her wrists. Her hair is styled up and back, and she has a serene expression. The base of the figurehead features ornamental scrollwork, resembling the curved forms typical of ship carvings. The entire figurehead appears to be floating against the smooth backdrop, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Figurehead
